title: Buyer beware
text:
Buyer beware. A little concerned with this item. It seemed like a really good deal and has a great look. It was scheduled to arrive today. I just received an email that the order is now delayed and has not shipped.

I picked this up late but it was slated to still be on time. Disappointed.
Hopefully the quality makes it worth it.
